collection.description: Two patients with similar symptoms respond differently to the same herbal preparation.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Two patients with similar symptoms respond differently to the same herbal preparation.

choices.label: Continue giving the remedy to both.
Stop the remedy and observe carefully.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: One patient improves while the other develops a troubling rash.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: Both recover, but the healer cannot prove the remedy was responsible.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The rash fades, and the healer records the suspected reaction.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The original illness worsens, requiring another approach.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The healer discovers that the plants were harvested at different stages.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The evidence remains inconclusive, teaching the apprentice to avoid easy assumptions.
